limitations: The regeneration examples have explicit healing in their reminder text, supported by rules 701.19 and 701.69. Activated regeneration creates a shield for the next destruction that turn; static regeneration replaces destruction directly.

Dr. McCoy, Surly Surgeon is excluded from released-paper access because its saved release date is November 13, 2026, after this review date.
